clips.title: The story
paras: On Fenris Isle, Rot Hide Ichor draws the Royal Apothecary Society’s attention. Apothecary Renferrel gathers it at the Sepulcher to learn what corrupted the gnolls and how to oppose them.

On Fenris Isle, Rot Hide gnolls are no ordinary beasts. Their bodies are decomposed and twisted by an unnatural blight, and a noxious ichor flows through their veins to sustain their animated flesh. The Royal Apothecary Society suspects the fluid may reveal how the pack was corrupted and who commands them from within the ruined keep.

At the Sepulcher, Apothecary Renferrel gathers vials of the ichor for study. The Forsaken hope to isolate the chemical and magical forces that fuel the gnolls, then find their weaknesses before sending troops across Lordamere Lake in a full assault.
